The second stage uses the same L and gm/Id as the mirror, which keeps systematic offset low. Itail is 20 uA and Cc is 1.2 pF, giving a first-stage slew rate of about 16 V/us and a GBW of about 15 MHz. I6 is 60 uA, so gm6 is roughly 4.5 times gm1. Rz cancels the zero. Gain is about 34 + 35 dB with L of 1 um."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),       # input pair L
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # PMOS mirror load + 2nd stage L (shared -> low offset)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # PMOS gm/Id (load and M6 identical density)
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # NMOS current-source L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),
    "I6":    (60e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.5e-12, 3e-12),
    "kz":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),       # Rz = kz/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    gmidn = 10.0
    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It/2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)       # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It/2, vds=1.0)                # mirror load
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)                  # 2nd stage CS
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)                    # bias diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.35)                      # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)                       # output sink
    Rz = p["kz"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)          # vinp side -> output node x
    n.dev("M2", "d", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)          # vinn side -> diode
    n.dev("M3", "d", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)              # diode
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)           # vinp up -> x down -> vout up
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    cx = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (cx * (Cc + cl) + Cc * cl))
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))           # mirror pole (half contributes)
    # zero with Rz: z = 1/(Cc*(1/gm6 - Rz)) -> LHP when Rz>1/gm6
    denom = (1.0 / m6.gm - Rz)
    zphase = 0.0
    if abs(denom) > 1e-12:
        fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * denom)
        zphase = math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / abs(fz))) * (1 if fz < 0 else -1)
    p4 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p4)) + zphase
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power}
